title: data-testid Injector
description: A CLI tool that automatically injects data-testid attributes into every input and button across your codebase — making your app instantly automation-ready without manual tagging.

title: Testability Scanner
description: A static analysis tool that audits your web app's testability score — flagging missing selectors, unstable locators, and automation blind spots before they become flaky tests.

title: End-to-end Tests
description: A comprehensive end-to-end test suite covering critical user flows — built to catch regressions early and ship with confidence.

title: Web3 E2E Testing Sandbox
description: A sandbox environment for running end-to-end tests against Web3 applications — simulating wallet interactions, on-chain transactions, and DeFi flows.
